content_sections.heading: KCB Accounts Officer Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the KCB Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download KCB Accounts Officer Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Accounts Officer: CA/ICMA Inter passed with completion of Articleship as per the mandatory requirements of the respective Institutes or M.Com. with Minimum 3 years post-qualification experience in the field of accounting and finance functions such as GST filing, IT filing, day-to-day accounts operations using advanced Tally or equivalent software up to the level of finalization of accounts, attending to internal/statutory audit, coordination with banks/FIs, clients, etc.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age: 29 years (as on 01 September 2026) To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the KCB Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 13-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of KCB to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the KCB Accounts Officer post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the Accounts Officer position at the Kerala Cashew Board is 13 October 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before the deadline to avoid technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Accounts Officer post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Accounts Officer position under the current recruitment notification released by the Kerala Cashew Board (KCB) for the year 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Accounts Officer post is 29 years as of 01 September 2026. Please ensure you meet this age criteria before submitting your application form.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Accounts Officer position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Accounts Officer post will receive a monthly consolidated salary of Rs. 35,000/-. This is a contract-based position offered by the Kerala Cashew Board.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a CA/ICMA Inter qualification with completed articleship or an M.Com degree with at least 3 years of post-qualification experience in accounting and finance functions, including GST and IT filing.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned in the official notification for any category, including General, OBC, SC, or ST candidates. The application process is free of cost for all eligible applicants.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for KCB recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves three main stages: a scrutiny of the submitted applications, followed by an interview for shortlisted candidates, and finally, a document verification process to confirm eligibility and credentials.

faq.question: Q8. Can I apply for this job offline?
faq.answer: No, the application mode for the KCB Accounts Officer recruitment is strictly online. Candidates must visit the official website or the provided application link to submit their details and documents electronically.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, the Accounts Officer position at the Kerala Cashew Board is a contract-based engagement. It is not a permanent government position, though it offers valuable experience in the public sector.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification?
faq.answer: The official notification can be found on the official website of the Kerala Cashew Board or via the CMD Kerala website. A direct link to the PDF is also provided in the Important Links section above.
